projects.name: Nexus Chat
projects.description: A Context Management System for Running LLMS Locally on device using llama.cpp and CUDA. Manages Different Context Windows or "chats" with a credit based Multi-User Management system which can be deployed to the whole world or in a private controlled environment.

projects.name: Lumina CUDA
projects.description: A real-time GPU-accelerated math function visualizer in C++/CUDA parallelizing computation across 777,600 pixels (1080x720) using 256 CUDA threads per block (16x16), with an ImGui overlay for live control.

projects.name: Echo Core - Agentic AI
projects.description: Flutter Application that takes Voice Commands and uses Natural Language Processing to classify and act accordingly. Uses a Locally running Tensorflow Model trained on a Fully Custom Dataset of over 10,000 commands ranging from "Set an alarm" to "Add 100 and 40" and many more.
